# Four-role evaluation preparation

This is an isolated, source-backed diagnostic input package. It prepares frozen
scenario inputs and compiler records for development/calibration/final/holdout
review. It does not contain gold labels, does not call Laya, and does not admit
an action to an owner or to Godot.

The eight trajectory groups are disjoint. Final and independent-holdout labels
are intentionally absent; authored holdout trajectories are reserved inputs,
not independently reviewed evidence. Numeric thresholds remain a development
proposal until calibration and policy review produce a signed revision.
